snippet.title: Zornhau | First Look: 2 Month Prototype
snippet.description:
Hey guys! Long time no see, I'm really excited about this update. The prototype is really coming along and a first playable is rapidly approaching. Zornhau is really starting to feel like a true game and not just a mechanics prototype like it was at the start. Can't wait to see you all in the first playtests later this Summer or Early Fall!

Join our Discord for more news and updates as well as signing up for playtests once it becomes available: https://discord.zornhau.io

Please make sure to like and subscribe, once we hit 100 subscribers we will be able to open a community page and start posting updates there as well!

Credit to Amoebacrew & Deskant for the music
